Nuclea-Moltex (web lead, ~2026-11-20): WNN and dealroom describe an agreement to acquire Moltex's technology portfolio, with completion pending UK NSIA approval and export licences. The lead's 'completes acquisition' is not supported. Not filed: it is an IP acquisition, not a buyer deal, and the Morpheus microreactor is at conceptual design.
Berkeley Odin LOI (Chiltern Vital Group with Cambridge Atomworks): WNN article dated 2026-07-07, outside the window and the 60-day gap. Not filed.
Dairyland Power with Applied Atomics LOI (announced 2026-10-22, Genoa WI): the reactor is 100 to 195 MWe, outside the 1-20 MW band. Not filed.

Oklo-Switch: no 2026 source found on whether any individual binding PPA has been signed. No current-status page was fetched, so no verdict was written. The Dec 2024 release supports 'non-binding' at signing only.

Eielson NOITA: no check written. The June 2026 CAMP newsletter and March 2026 fact sheet are consistent with the shipped NOITA wording (contract follows NRC licensing; licensing decision pending). Not fetched as a primary page.
canada-src: not re-checked. vendors.json already carries a fetched SRC FAQ verification dated 2026-08-23 for the cancellation.
equinix-radiant: not re-checked; the deposits/pre-orders reading is settled in skip/recently-checked.md.
Buckley (anpi-buckley): no 2026 agreement beyond the April 2026 ANPI selection and a July 2026 DOE HALEU allocation found; no check written.
Forged Rings reservation by Oklo (2026-11-06) is a supplier capacity deal, not a buyer deal; not filed.

Malmstrom 'two acres' claim: the fetched Westinghouse release states no acreage, and the Exchange Monitor excerpt is paywalled, so the full article was not read. The claim is recorded as unsupported on what was read.

checks.claim: Five vendors selected for five named bases on 2026-08-26, up to $2.2bn across FY2027-FY2031 under milestone-based Other Transactions agreements the Army says it is negotiating; four of the nine candidate sites are still unassigned
checks.evidence: Army release dated 2026-08-26 lists five awardees and bases (Antares at Fort Bragg, BWXT at Fort Campbell, General Atomics at Fort Hood, Radiant at Fort Benning, Westinghouse Government Services at Fort Drum). It describes about $2.2 billion across FY2027-2031 and says the Army 'down-selected potential industry awardees for negotiation' of Other Transactions Authority-based agreements. It says 'Additional Army and other Service sites will be announced at a later date.' The four-unassigned figure is the nine candidates less five named bases.

checks.claim: Oklo's Groves Isotope Test Reactor afterward on 2026-08-05 — five critical as of this research
checks.evidence: DOE Office of Nuclear Energy release dated 2026-08-06 says Oklo's Groves Isotope Test Reactor 'successfully achieved criticality' at the company's facility in Lockhart, Texas, reached 'Last night' relative to that date (so 2026-08-05), and calls Groves the fifth DOE-authorized advanced reactor to reach criticality. No later criticality was found in searches run 2026-11-22.

checks.claim: Factory-built transportable unit; vendor states 5 MWe on sites as small as two acres
checks.evidence: Westinghouse release dated 2026-04-23 gives 5 MWe and says the unit runs 'eight-plus years without refueling', but states no acreage. The Exchange Monitor article (2026-04-27) is paywalled; its visible text states no acreage, so the full article was not read. The two-acre figure is not found in any fetched source.
